body:
Ank — Anti Naked Kill
A fully configurable Paper 1.21.1 plugin that prevents players from killing others who aren't properly equipped. Almost every behavior can be tuned through the config file.

Features

Impossible to kill players with no armor in their inventory
Define custom regions where protection is active or inactive
In-game wand tool for fast cuboid region selection
Reload config and regions live with /ank reload — no restart needed

Commands
CommandDescription
/ank wandG ives you the selection wand
/ank region create <name> Saves a cuboid region from your two selections
/ank region delete <name Removes a named region
/ank region list Lists all regions with world and corners
/ank reload Reloads config and regions
